 Match Predictions: ICC CWC League 2 2026 - Match 145 - UAE vs Oman - November 4th
 Match Predictions: ICC CWC League 2 2026 - Match 145 ©REUTERS 
 By Cricket World Staff 
 Tuesday 3 November 2026 
 ICC CWC League 2 
 ODI series Schedule 145th ODI, Dubai Live United Arab Emirates 0/0 Oman OMA elected to bowl
 Oman elected to bowl
 Live scores and commentary 
 Here are the Predictions for the ICC CWC League 2 2026, Match 145 - UAE vs Oman, to be played on the 4th of November at the ICC Academy, Dubai.
 Match Prediction - United Arab Emirates v Oman 
 Match 145 - UAE vs Oman (ICC Academy, Dubai) 
 Ground Stat:
 Average First Innings Total at ICC Academy, Dubai (ODI's) - 244 
 Average Second Innings Total at ICC Academy, Dubai (ODI's) - 216 
 Batting Stats ODI 
 Current Form UAE:
 UAE are currently placed at the bottom most position on ICC CWC League 2 points table with 10 wins, 22 losses and 3 No Result Matches to their credit. 
 The top run scorer for UAE in the ICC CWC League 2 is Rahul Chopra with 764 runs to his name. 
 The top wicket taker for UAE in the ICC CWC League 2 is Junaid Siddique with 40 scalps under his belt. 
 UAE have won their previous match against Netherlands by 5 wickets.
 Netherlands batted first and they posted a total of 263 for 4 in 50 overs. Cedric de Lange got out for a golden duck. After his dismissal, Noah Croes also threw it away and Netherlands looked in troubled waters. Max O'Dowd once again showcased his class and smashed 106 runs in 119 balls, hitting 10 fours and 3 sixes. Scott Edwards also contributed healthily with a knock of 94 runs as Netherlands managed to get to a competitive total of 263 in 50 overs of play.
 During the chase, UAE lost 3 early wickets and couldn't get off to an ideal start. However, youngsters Adeeb Usmani and Akshdeep Nath had their back. Usmani made 81 off 93 balls while Nath scored 99 runs off only 88 balls, collecting 5 fours and 4 sixes. On the back of such brilliant knocks from both of them, UAE got home in the 49th over with 5 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Oman:
 Oman are currently placed at the 4th position on ICC CWC League 2 points table with 15 wins, 17 losses and 3 No Result Matches to their credit. 
 The top run scorer for Oman in the ICC CWC League 2 is Jatinder Singh with 1110 runs to his name. 
 The top wicket taker for Oman in the ICC CWC League 2 is Shakeel Ahmed with 56 scalps under his belt. 
 Oman have lost their previous match against Netherlands by 7 wickets.
 Oman batted first and they posted a total of 182 before being bowled out. Jeet Shah, Hammad Mirza and Aryan Bisht got out without troubling the scorers much. Jatinder Singh also got out after taking a nice start. Mujibur Imran Ali and Vinayak Shukla fought hard in the middle order, scoring 44 and 38 runs respectively but these knocks weren't enough to take Oman to a competitive total. They were eventually bowled out for just 182 on board. For Netherlands, Colin Ackermann picked up 4 wickets for only 23 runs in his spell of 10 overs.
 During the chase, Max O'Dowd and Cedric de Lange started off very well. Max O'Dowd scored a quickfire 29 before being dismissed by Nadeem Khan. Cedric de Lange and Zach Lion Cachet then took the responsibility of taking Netherlands over the line. Lange made 79 runs while Cachet scored 68 runs in 75 deliveries as Netherlands managed to chase the target down in the 36th over itself with 7 wickets in hand.
